title: AuthorizationContext
description: Context passed into Cedar policy evaluations at trust boundary TB-5. Derived strictly from trusted server-side state, never from untrusted client or LLM input.

approved_by_analyst.description: True if an authenticated SOC Analyst has explicitly approved this action in the UI.

approved_by_admin.description: True if an authenticated Security Admin has approved this action with elevated credentials.

approval_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when human approval was granted. Null if pending.

request_source.description: Verified caller origin established by Cognito JWT / IAM session.

mfa_authenticated.description: True if caller session was verified with Multi-Factor Authentication (required for High risk).

risk_level.description: Risk tier of the target action from the Phase 7 / Phase 8 taxonomy.

target_matches_incident.description: True if target entity (user_id/source_ip/device_id) exists in the verified incident's involved_entities.

incident_id.description: Target incident ID if action is scoped to an incident.
